name: CID Borrow a Backup Battery
description: Borrow portable batteries during Public Safety Power Shutoffs for those requiring electricity for medical reasons
fullDescription: The Center for Independence of Individuals with Disabilities (CID) provides portable backup batteries to individuals who depend on electricity for medical equipment during Public Safety Power Shutoffs (PSPS).
whatTheyOffer:
- Loaner portable backup batteries for people who need power for medical reasons
- Highest priority for people who use life-sustaining electrical equipment
- Help signing up for PG&E's Medical Baseline program to lower your energy bill
- Tools to help you make a personal disaster plan
- Support during a PSPS or other disaster, in partnership with CFILC and Peninsula Clean Energy
howToGetIt:
1. Call CID at 650-645-1780 or email info@cidsanmateo.org
2. Tell them about the medical equipment you need to keep powered
3. Ask for help enrolling in Medical Baseline and making a disaster plan
4. Contact CID when a PSPS is announced to arrange a loaner battery
address: 2001 Winward Way, Suite 103, San Mateo, CA 94404
keywords: CID, backup battery, PSPS, power shutoff, medical equipment, CPAP, oxygen, Medical Baseline, disability, emergency power
